**Not in parity.** 2 of 25 gates fail.

**Figma data was not refreshed in this run.** The audit used the committed snapshots (the oldest, figma/vars.snapshot.json, updated today). To refresh them: rms-design-system-engine --recipe refresh-figma.

  - [sizing/-] radius/control → --hb-radius-control
    - Fix:  styles/tokens.css:10 - change --hb-radius-control: 4px → 6px

- **Component props match Figma** fails:
  - badge/Tone: the code names it "tone" (letter case T → t)  (components/HbBadge.vue)
  - badge/Tone: default differs - Figma "Neutral" vs code "tone=neutral" (the code writes it "neutral")  (components/HbBadge.vue)
  - badge/Tone: code prop "tone" is missing Figma variant option(s) "Neutral" (the code writes it "neutral"), "Success" (the code writes it "success"), "Danger" (the code writes it "danger")  (components/HbBadge.vue)
  - iconButton: Figma's annotation says role button; the code needs a spoken name (its text, or aria-label when it shows only an icon) (owed: Figma's annotation or the person says what)  (components/HbIconButton.vue)
